tiers.description: When completing the construction of a House, a Villager is trained for free at the Town Center, up to a maximum of 20 Villagers.
When completing the construction of a House, a Villager is trained for free at the Town Center, up to a maximum of 20 Villagers. 50% chance to train 2 Villagers instead.
Immediately advance to the Feudal Age and gain all Feudal Age upgrades.
Immediately advance to the Feudal Age and gain all Feudal Age upgrades. Then gain enough resources for advancing to the Castle Age.
All sources of Gold income increased by 50%.
All sources of Gold income increased by 75%.
Gain a permanent Gold trickle of 300 per minute.
Gain a permanent Gold trickle of 450 per minute.
Increases resources deposited by Villagers by +10%.
Increases resources deposited by Villagers by +15%.
Cavalry units cost 60% less gold.
Cavalry units cost 60% less gold and 20% less food.
Cavalry attack 30% faster and gain +4 damage.
Cavalry attack 30% faster and gain +6 damage.
All units gain 200% more health and damage.
All units gain 300% more health and damage.
Gain an ability: Supremacy. All current Villagers permanently become Men-at-Arms. Grants Elite Men-at-Arms upgrade.
Gain an ability: Supremacy. All current Villagers permanently become Men-at-Arms with +2 armor. Grants Elite Men-at-Arms upgrade.
Whenever an upgrade is completed, all military units gain 5% health and 5% damage.
Whenever an upgrade is completed, all military units gain 7.5% health and 7.5% damage.
Siege Weapon units gain +20% damage.
Siege Weapon units gain +30% damage.
Cavalry units gain +20% damage.
Cavalry units gain +30% damage.
Melee Infantry units gain +25% damage.
Melee Infantry units gain +35% damage.
Ranged Infantry units gain +25% damage.
Ranged Infantry units gain +35% damage.
Gain an explosive cart immediately and every 3 minutes at the Wonder. Detonate to deal large area damage.
Gain an explosive cart immediately and every 2 minutes at the Wonder. Detonate to deal large area damage.
Gain an ability: Growth Fund. Spend 100 Food, Wood, and Gold to increase the health of all units and buildings by 5%. The cost doubles each time the ability is used.
Gain an ability: Growth Fund. Spend 100 Food, Wood, and Gold to increase the health of all units and buildings by 8%. The cost doubles each time the ability is used.
Handcannoneers gain a piercing shot that travels through multiple enemy units.
Handcannoneers gain a piercing shot that travels through multiple enemy units and gain 1 tile weapon range.
Immediately gain 2 random Boons.
Immediately gain 2 Boon choices.
When dealing a finishing blow, Melee Infantry heal 250 health.
When dealing a finishing blow, Melee Infantry heal 250 health and gain 5 armor for 10 seconds.
Cavalry units lost in battle return to the field as Spearmen from the Wonder.
Cavalry units lost in battle return to the field as armored Mercenary Spearmen from the Wonder.
Gain an ability: Mobilization. All military unit and upgrade production is 800% faster for 10 seconds.
Gain an ability: Mobilization. All military unit and upgrade production is 800% faster for 30 seconds.
Outposts, Keeps, and Town Centers permanently have all available garrison arrows active.
Outposts, Keeps, and Town Centers permanently have all available garrison arrows active. Immediately spawn a Villager at each building with a hold.
Deploy 1 Siege Battery anywhere on the map which automatically targets enemy units in a large area with a powerful Mangonel emplacement.
Deploy 2 Siege Batteries anywhere on the map which automatically target enemy units in a large area with powerful Mangonel emplacements.
Hero and Champion units gain 20% health and damage for each one you have and 10% health and damage for each one your ally has. Get a random Champion at the Wonder.
Hero and Champion units gain 25% health and damage for each one you have and 15% health and damage for each one your ally has. Get a random Champion at the Wonder.
Outposts can have all Emplacements at the same time. Outpost Emplacements are 50% cheaper.
Outposts can have all Emplacements at the same time. Outpost Emplacements are 75% cheaper.

Destroyed outposts automatically rebuild themselves when no enemies are nearby.
Max 15 outposts.

Destroyed outposts automatically rebuild themselves 100% faster when no enemies are nearby.
Max 15 outposts.

Gain a Delhi War Elephant Hero at the Wonder. Enemy units near The Behemoth become frightened, dealing 25% less damage.
A slain hero will eventually return at the Wonder.

Gain a Delhi War Elephant Hero at the Wonder. Enemy units near The Behemoth become frightened, dealing 25% less damage. Has 50% more health.
All Heroes respawn 20% faster.
Gain an ability: Boggy Ground. Creates an area of terrain that slows enemy units movement and attack speed by 85% and reduces armor by 1.
Gain an ability: Boggy Ground. Creates an area of terrain that slows enemy units movement and attack speed by 85%, reduces armor by 3, and poisons over time. Recharges twice as fast.
Reveal all resource caches on the map and increase their value by 50%.
Reveal all resource caches on the map and increase their value by 75%.
Attract all animals across the map to gather at the nearest Town Center and increase their food by 50%.
Attract all animals across the map to gather at the nearest Town Center and increase their food by 75%.
Spearmen are 50% cheaper.
Spearmen are 50% cheaper and gain 2 ranged armor.

Gain a Byzantine Cavalry Hero at the Wonder, a powerful warrior that increases the health of nearby allied cavalry by 35%.
A slain hero will eventually return at the Wonder.

Gain a Byzantine Cavalry Hero at the Wonder, a powerful warrior that increases the health of nearby allied cavalry by 35%. Has 50% more health.
All Heroes respawn 20% faster.
All units and emplacements have a 2% chance to deal a critical hit, which deals 500% damage.
All units and emplacements have a 2% chance to deal a critical hit, which deals 500% damage. Units heal to full health whenever hitting a crit.
Gain an ability: Holy Smite. Strikes 5 random enemy units in a targeted area for 1000 damage each.
Gain an ability: Holy Smite. Strikes 5 random enemy units in a targeted area for 1000 damage each. Strikes 2 additional units for each Relic collected.
Archers gain +2 tiles of range and +10% attack speed.
Archers gain +3 tiles of range and +15% attack speed.
Villagers and Traders gain 150% more health and reflect 20 damage back to melee attackers whenever they are hit.
Villagers and Traders gain 225% more health and reflect 30 damage back to melee attackers whenever they are hit.
Grants a one-time ability to spawn a giant tree with 50000 Wood. Every 1000 Wood gathered from it increases building health by 3%.
Grants a one-time ability to spawn a giant tree with 50000 Wood. Every 600 Wood gathered from it increases building health by 3%.
Gain 150 resources per minute trickle of Food, Wood, or Gold, whichever is lowest.
Upgrades Equilibrium. Gain 400 resources per minute trickle of Food, Wood, or Gold, whichever is lowest.
Your Villagers find some old bones and tell some tall tales. Gain 3 new Relics at the Town Center.
Your Villagers find some old bones and tell some tall tales. Gain 4 new Relics at the Town Center.
Reduces Town Center cost and build time by 60%. Enables construction of Town Centers in the Dark Age.
Reduces Town Center cost and build time by 60%. Enables construction of Town Centers in the Dark Age. Your next Town Center is free.
Berry bushes gain 250 more food, Villagers gather berries 100% faster.
Berry bushes gain 500 more food, Villagers gather berries 100% faster.
Crossbowmen damage ignores all armor.
Crossbowmen damage ignores all armor. Crossbowmen deal +20% more bonus damage.
All units gain 10% of their maximum health as bonus damage on charge.
All units gain 20% of their maximum health as bonus damage on charge and 10% more health.
Whenever a Trebuchet hits an enemy unit, spawn a Man at Arms with no armor.
Whenever a Trebuchet hits an enemy unit, spawn a Man at Arms with no armor. Trebuchets attack 50% faster.

Gain an English Infantry Hero at the Wonder, a powerful warrior that increases the health of nearby allied infantry by 30%.
A slain hero will eventually return at the Wonder.

Gain an English Infantry Hero at the Wonder, a powerful warrior that increases the health of nearby allied infantry by 30%. Has 50% more health.
All Heroes respawn 20% faster.
Infantry that receive a killing blow enter Last Stand, returning to full health and gaining +50% damage. During Last Stand, health is rapidly depleted by 8% per second.
Infantry that receive a killing blow enter Last Stand, returning to full health gaining +50% damage and +35% damage reduction. During Last Stand, health is rapidly depleted by 8% per second.
All units permanently heal 45 health per minute.
All units permanently heal 45 health per minute and an additional 15 health for each Relic collected.
When completing a side objective, immediately pick a new Boon.
When completing a side objective, immediately pick a new Boon. Gain a third Boon for completing both side objectives.
Gain an ability: Panic Button. Gain 30 seconds of 100% damage reduction on all units. Can only be used once.
Gain an ability: Panic Button. Gain 60 seconds of 100% damage reduction on all units. Can only be used once.
Deploy a camp anywhere on the map where allied Privateers gather and assist in combat while also sharing a portion of their plundered gold.
Deploy a camp anywhere on the map where additional allied Privateers gather and assist in combat while also sharing a greater portion of their plundered gold.
Gain a Prized N'Dama Cattle at the Capital Town Center which has 2000 Food. When fully gathered, all units are beefed up with 10% more health.
Gain a Prized N'Dama Cattle at the Capital Town Center which has 2000 Food. When fully gathered, all units are beefed up with 15% more health.
Reveal all Sacred Sites. For each Sacred Site held, all damage is reduced by 5%.
Reveal all Sacred Sites. For each Sacred Site held, all damage is reduced by 7.5%.
Battering Rams heal loaded units for 5 health per second and gain 20% move speed for each unit loaded.
Battering Rams heal loaded units for 8 health per second and gain 20% move speed for each unit loaded.
Grants a global ability that heals up to 100 health on all friendly units and gives them +30% damage for 20 seconds.
Grants a global ability that heals up to 150 health on all friendly units and gives them +45% damage for 30 seconds.
Deploy 3 powerful Grand Outposts with upgraded Springalds anywhere on the map. Gain an additional charge every 5 minutes.
Deploy 3 powerful Grand Outposts with upgraded Springalds anywhere on the map. Gain an additional charge every 5 minutes. Grand Outposts have 50% more health.

Gain a Hero Springald at the Wonder, a powerful Springald that fires 3 shots and has vastly increased health and armor.

Gain a Hero Springald at the Wonder, a powerful Springald that fires 3 shots and has vastly increased health and armor. Has 50% more health.

Units standing on walls gain 1 more range and 20% more damage.
Units standing on walls gain 1 more range and 40% more damage.

Gain an ability: Training Dummies. Target an area to deploy Training Dummies that draw aggression from enemy units and explode on death. Dummies have 50% more health and a bigger boom.
